233:     pub(crate) fn get_syntax_for(&self, path: impl AsRef<Path>) -> Option<MappingTarget<'a>> {
234:         // Try matching on the file name as-is.
235:         let candidate = Candidate::new(&path);
236:         let candidate_filename = path.as_ref().file_name().map(Candidate::new);
237:         let options = &self.ignored_suffixes.glob_options;
238:         for (ref glob, ref syntax) in self.mappings.iter().rev() {
239:             if (options.match_full_path && glob.is_match_candidate(&candidate))
240:                 || candidate_filename.as_ref().map_or(false, |filename| {
241:                     options.match_file_name && glob.is_match_candidate(filename)
242:                 })
243:             {
244:                 return Some(*syntax);
245:             }
246:         }
247:         // Try matching on the file name after removing an ignored suffix.
248:         let file_name = path.as_ref().file_name()?;
249:         self.ignored_suffixes
250:             .try_with_stripped_suffix(file_name, |stripped_file_name| {
251:                 Ok(self.get_syntax_for(stripped_file_name))
252:             })

19:             case_insensitive: false,
20:             literal_separator: true,
21:             backslash_escape: !std::path::is_separator('\\'),
22:             match_full_path: true,
23:             match_file_name: true,
24:         }
25:     }
26: }

28: #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
29: pub struct IgnoredSuffixes<'a> {
30:     values: Vec<&'a str>,
31:     pub(crate) glob_options: GlobMatchOptions,
32: }
33: 
34: impl Default for IgnoredSuffixes<'_> {
35:     fn default() -> Self {
36:         Self {
37:             glob_options: GlobMatchOptions::default(),
38:             values: vec![
39:                 // Editor etc backups
40:                 "~",
41:                 ".bak",
42:                 ".old",
43:                 ".orig",
44:                 // Debian and derivatives apt/dpkg/ucf backups
45:                 ".dpkg-dist",
46:                 ".dpkg-new",
47:                 ".dpkg-old",
48:                 ".dpkg-tmp",
49:                 ".ucf-dist",
50:                 ".ucf-new",
51:                 ".ucf-old",
52:                 // Red Hat and derivatives rpm backups
53:                 ".rpmnew",
54:                 ".rpmorig",
55:                 ".rpmsave",
56:                 // Build system input/template files
57:                 ".in",
58:             ],
59:         }
60:     }
61: }
62: 
63: impl<'a> IgnoredSuffixes<'a> {
64:     pub fn add_suffix(&mut self, suffix: &'a str) {
65:         self.values.push(suffix)
66:     }
67: 
68:     pub fn strip_suffix(&self, file_name: &'a str) -> Option<&'a str> {
69:         for suffix in self.values.iter() {
70:             if let Some(stripped_file_name) = file_name.strip_suffix(suffix) {
71:                 return Some(stripped_file_name);
72:             }
73:         }
74:         None
75:     }
76: 
77:     /// If we find an ignored suffix on the file name, e.g. '~', we strip it and
78:     /// then try again without it.
79:     pub fn try_with_stripped_suffix<T, F>(&self, file_name: &'a OsStr, func: F) -> Result<Option<T>>
80:     where
81:         F: Fn(&'a OsStr) -> Result<Option<T>>,
82:     {
83:         if let Some(file_str) = Path::new(file_name).to_str() {
84:             if let Some(stripped_file_name) = self.strip_suffix(file_str) {
85:                 return func(OsStr::new(stripped_file_name));
86:             }
87:         }
88:         Ok(None)
89:     }
90: }

.arg("map-syntax\_case.Config")

.assert()

part.text:
Fixed. The issue was that `--map-syntax` glob matching was case-sensitive, so `*.config` wouldn't match `NuGet.Config`.

**Change:** src/syntax_mapping/ignored_suffixes.rs:19 — set `case_insensitive: true` in `GlobMatchOptions::default()` (this option is applied to every glob in `SyntaxMapping::insert` at src/syntax_mapping.rs:219). Also added the CHANGELOG entry, mirroring upstream PR #2650.

**Verification:** The previously failing regression test `highlighting_independant_from_map_syntax_case` now passes, and the full test suite passes (47 unit + 125 integration + others, 0 failures).
